summary: The change passes. The M20 check that refused any file kind missing from docs/non-rust-files.md is replaced by one aimed at code, as asked. It flags files in another language by extension or by a `#!` first line, and it handles Rust's `#![` correctly. Data and documents now pass anywhere, so a JSON test fixture needs no ledger entry. A named two-entry allow-list (setup.sh and the CI workflow) gives a reason for each entry. docs/non-rust-files.md, the M20 row in enforcement.md, D33, the design doc, the requirements map and the CHANGELOG are all updated, and every changed file is on the deliverables list. I ran `cargo test -p xtask`, `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked -q`, and all passed. That includes the new stray-script test and the M19 and M24 checks. One minor gap: nothing checks that the allow-list in docs/non-rust-files.md matches the constant in the test. The docs only say the two are 'kept in step'.
